meta.formTitle: Visa Application Form to Enter Japan
meta.issuingAuthority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

fields.label: Surname / Family Name
fields.hint: Enter exactly as printed in your passport — typically all capitals.

fields.label: Given & Middle Names
fields.hint: Enter first and middle names exactly as printed on your passport.
fields.formRef: Given and middle names (as shown in passport)

fields.label: Other / Former Names
fields.hint: Any other names you are or have been known by. Write 'None' if not applicable.
fields.formRef: Other names (including any other names you are or have been known by)

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.hint: Use DD/MM/YYYY format — same as on your passport.

fields.label: Place of Birth
fields.hint: City and country where you were born.
fields.formRef: Place of birth (City, State or Province, Country)

fields.label: Sex
fields.hint: Tick 'Male' or 'Female' to match your passport.

fields.label: Marital Status
fields.hint: Select one: Single, Married, Widowed, or Divorced.
fields.formRef: Marital status: Single / Married / Widowed / Divorced

fields.label: Nationality / Citizenship
fields.hint: Your current nationality exactly as shown in the passport.

fields.label: Former / Other Nationalities
fields.hint: List any previous or dual nationalities. Write 'None' if not applicable.
fields.formRef: Former and/or other nationalities or citizenships

fields.label: Passport Type
fields.hint: Tick the correct box: Diplomatic, Official, Ordinary, or Other. Most travellers select 'Ordinary'.
fields.formRef: Passport type: Diplomatic / Official / Ordinary / Other

fields.label: Passport Number
fields.hint: The alphanumeric code on the bio-data page of your passport.

fields.label: Passport Issue Date
fields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY format as printed in your passport.

fields.label: Passport Expiry Date
fields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY format. Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your intended entry date.
fields.warning: Passport must have a minimum 6 months validity from the date you enter Japan. Renew before applying if it expires sooner.

fields.label: Place of Issue
fields.hint: City where the passport was issued.

fields.label: Issuing Authority
fields.hint: The authority that issued the passport, e.g., the Ministry of External Affairs.

fields.label: National ID Number
fields.hint: ID number issued to you by your government (e.g., Aadhaar, PAN, NIC). Leave blank if none.
fields.formRef: ID No. issued to you by your government

fields.label: Current Occupation / Position
fields.hint: Your current job title. Use 'Student', 'Homemaker', or 'Self-Employed' if applicable.
fields.formRef: Current profession or occupation and position

fields.label: Employer / School Name
fields.hint: Full registered name of your current employer or educational institution.

fields.label: Employer / School Address
fields.hint: Full postal address of your employer or school.

fields.label: Employer Phone Number
fields.hint: Office landline or HR number with country code.

fields.label: Home / Residential Address
fields.hint: Your full current home address. If you have more than one address, list them all.
fields.example: 12 MG Road, Connaught Place, New Delhi 110001

fields.label: Personal Phone Number
fields.hint: Your mobile number with country code. The embassy may call to confirm details.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.hint: An email you check regularly — all correspondence from the embassy may go here.

fields.label: Intended Date of Arrival in Japan
fields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY — the date your flight lands in Japan.
fields.warning: Book flexible/refundable tickets before applying, as the visa may be issued for different dates.

fields.label: Intended Length of Stay
fields.hint: Total number of days (not nights) you plan to stay in Japan.
fields.formRef: Intended length of stay in Japan

fields.label: Port of Entry into Japan
fields.hint: The airport or port where you will first enter Japan.

fields.label: Name of Ship or Airline
fields.hint: Airline name and flight number if known. Leave blank if not yet booked.

fields.label: Purpose of Visit / Status of Residence
fields.hint: Select the closest option. For tourism write 'Temporary Visitor' or 'Tourism'.
fields.formRef: Purpose of visit to Japan / Status of residence

fields.label: Address / Hotel in Japan
fields.hint: Full name and address of where you will stay on your first night. Give hotel name and postal address.
fields.example: Shinjuku Granbell Hotel, 2-14-5 Kabukicho, Shinjuku, Tokyo 160-0021
fields.formRef: Names and addresses of hotels or persons with whom applicant intends to stay

fields.label: Previous Stays in Japan
fields.hint: List dates and duration of all previous visits to Japan. Write 'None' if first visit.
fields.formRef: Dates and duration of previous stays in Japan

fields.label: Certificate of Eligibility Number
fields.hint: Only fill if you have a Certificate of Eligibility issued by Japanese Immigration. Most tourists leave this blank.

fields.label: Guarantor Name (in Japan)
fields.hint: Name of the person or organisation acting as your guarantor in Japan. Write 'N/A' if self-funded tourist with no guarantor.
fields.formRef: Guarantor or reference in Japan — Name

fields.label: Guarantor Date of Birth
fields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY. Leave blank or 'N/A' if no guarantor.

fields.label: Guarantor Nationality & Immigration Status
fields.hint: Nationality and current visa/immigration status of the guarantor in Japan.

fields.label: Guarantor Occupation
fields.hint: Job title and employer of the guarantor.
fields.formRef: Guarantor — Profession or occupation and position

fields.label: Guarantor Address
fields.hint: Full address of the guarantor in Japan.

fields.label: Guarantor Phone Number
fields.hint: Contact number of the guarantor, including country code.

fields.label: Guarantor Relationship to Applicant
fields.hint: How the guarantor is related to you (e.g., Friend, Relative, Employer, Travel Agency).

fields.label: Inviter Name (in Japan)
fields.hint: If the inviting person and guarantor are the same, write 'Same as above'. Otherwise enter their full name.

fields.label: Inviter Date of Birth
fields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY. Write 'Same as above' or 'N/A' as applicable.

fields.label: Inviter Nationality & Immigration Status
fields.hint: Nationality and immigration status of the inviter.

fields.label: Inviter Occupation
fields.hint: Job title and employer of the inviter in Japan.
fields.formRef: Inviter — Profession or occupation and position

fields.label: Inviter Address
fields.hint: Full address of the inviter in Japan.

fields.label: Inviter Phone Number
fields.hint: Contact number of the inviter.

fields.label: Inviter Relationship to Applicant
fields.hint: How the inviter is related to you.

fields.label: Ever Convicted of a Crime?
fields.hint: Answer Yes or No. If Yes, provide details in the remarks box.
fields.warning: Answering 'Yes' does not automatically disqualify you — provide full details. Providing false information can result in visa denial and future bans.
fields.formRef: Have you ever been convicted of a crime or offence in any country?

fields.label: Ever Sentenced to 1+ Year Imprisonment?
fields.hint: Answer Yes or No. This includes suspended sentences.
fields.warning: This includes suspended sentences. Tick 'Yes' if you received any sentence of 1 year or more, even if not served.
fields.formRef: Have you ever been sentenced to imprisonment for 1 year or more in any country?

fields.label: Ever Convicted of a Drug Offence?
fields.hint: Answer Yes or No. Covers narcotics, marijuana, stimulants, or psychotropic substances.
fields.warning: Includes suspended sentences. A drug conviction can result in permanent visa denial for Japan.
fields.formRef: Have you ever been convicted for a drug offence in any country?

fields.label: Ever Deported or Removed from Any Country?
fields.hint: Answer Yes or No. Covers overstaying visas or violating immigration laws anywhere in the world.
fields.warning: Past deportation from Japan or any country must be disclosed. Concealment can result in being permanently barred from Japan.
fields.formRef: Have you ever been deported or removed from Japan or any country?

fields.label: Ever Engaged in Prostitution-Related Activity?
fields.hint: Answer Yes or No.
fields.formRef: Have you ever engaged in prostitution or related activities?

fields.label: Ever Committed Trafficking in Persons?
fields.hint: Answer Yes or No.
fields.formRef: Have you ever committed trafficking in persons?

fields.label: Remarks / Special Circumstances
fields.hint: Use this space for any 'Yes' answers above or any special circumstances (medical conditions, multiple entries, etc.). Note: these fields are optional per the form.
fields.formRef: Remarks / Special circumstances, if any (Note: not mandatory)

fields.label: Partner's Occupation (or Parent's if Minor)
fields.hint: Occupation of your spouse/partner, or your parents' occupation if you are under 18. Note: optional per the form.
fields.formRef: (Note) Partner's profession/occupation (or that of parents, if applicant is a minor)
